findings.claim: All three new browser test files paste the same build-serve-launch beforeAll/afterAll block (about 18 lines each). The existing export `setup()` in tests/ui/hud-motion.ts already does exactly this and is used by eight hud-motion-*.test.ts files.
findings.evidence: locked-card-shake.test.ts:312-328, locked-card-rest.test.ts:211-227 and track-select-many-cards.test.ts:557-573 each declare `let dist/server/browser/origin`, then `beforeAll(async () => { dist = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), '…-')); await build({ configFile: 'harness/screens/vite.config.ts', logLevel: 'silent', build: { outDir: dist, emptyOutDir: true } }); ({ origin, server } = await serve(dist)); browser = await launch(); }, 120_000); afterAll(async () => { await browser?.close(); server?.close(); rmSync(dist, …) });`. The same body is in tests/ui/hud-motion.ts:42-65 `export function setup(): { browser(): Browser; origin(): string }`, used as `const env = setup();` in tests/ui/hud-motion-entry.test.ts:7, hud-motion-events.test.ts:7 and others. The only difference is the tmpdir prefix, which is cosmetic. The clone report missed it because that one prefix line breaks the 6-line identical run.
findings.suggestedFix: In the three new files (all new on this branch, so they can still be edited), replace the let-declarations and the beforeAll/afterAll blocks with `const env = setup();` imported from './hud-motion.ts'. Use `env.browser()` and `env.origin()` in the tests. This also drops the `if (!browser) throw` guards and the fs/os/path/vite/Server imports.

checked.how: It reports no clones. I re-checked the diff by hand and found the near-identical test setup in F1, which the 6-line rule misses because of one differing line.
Grepped src for matchMedia and reduced-motion. The only JS reduced-motion check is screen-change.ts:19, and the diff reuses it by exporting it instead of copying it. Good.
Grepped `.animate(` in src and tests. track-card.ts:73 is the only Web Animations call, so no existing shake or animation helper was skipped.

It reuses the exported stageTrackCards. Its inline `bests` and `locked` are one-liners with different data from start.stage's private helpers (one best, not two), so reusing them wouldn't make anything smaller.

checked.target: start-screen pick() locked guard after the track-card click change
checked.how: Clicks on locked cards no longer reach onPick, but pick() is still called by select() and show() with ids that may be locked, so the guard at start-screen.ts:45 still runs and isn't dead.

checked.target: track-card keydown vs start-screen radiogroup keydown
checked.how: The card handles only Enter/Space on locked cards. The group handles only arrow keys. They don't overlap and neither copies the other.

checked.target: tests/ui/locked-card.ts helpers vs existing test helpers
checked.how: Grepped exports in tests/ui. Nothing reads Web Animations keyframes or a settled pose. hud-motion.ts SNAP is a string while the new test compares parsed numbers, too small to flag.
Nothing is in flight. B14 isn't started and no merged PR does the shake or the scrolling row, so nothing is repeated.
The new rules (overflow, snap, min-width, desktop min-width) only add to .ui-start__cards and .ui-track-card. They copy no other block, and no old rule was left superseded.
